component.name: Amphi Cloud
component.summary: A self-hosted cloud for secure file storage

description.p: Amphi Cloud is a free and open-source, cross-platform cloud storage app for effortless file archiving and previewing.

Organize your documents, images, videos, and more into folders, and quickly preview files without opening them — perfect for managing your personal or work archive. Keep your archive under control: sync your files across devices via a self-hosted server, so everything is accessible wherever you are.
If you already use Amphi Notes, Amphi Music and Amphi Photos, your notes, music library, and photos can also be synced through the same server.
To set up your own server, visit: https://amphi.site
